input.content:
STAGE: read rubric + both finalists + frozen evidence bundle (comparison note, no verdict yet).
GOAL: establish which rubric dimensions discriminate A (cocond-markov-poincare-ot) from B (CURVCELL-SID), since both cite the identical observed block E4-E11.
READ: rubric-2026-10-v1 (behavior_evidence 20, geometry_necessity 20, novelty 20, downstream 15, falsifiability 10, implementability 10, exploration 5); IDEA A spec (Poincare ground cost, 3x Sinkhorn sweeps with one Markov diffusion step B_bt@P, argmax plan -> log_0(c_j*) with straight-through, Klein/Einstein barycenter code update, alpha/q "measured never tuned"); IDEA B spec (per-code curvature field s[l][k]=sqrt(kappa) from branching B[l][k]=exp(H) of successor code-groups, 12 cumulative-mean refreshes, d_B/s in argmin and commitment, no gradient into s).
OBSERVED: evidence bundle E4-E11 is byte-identical for both, so all discriminating power is in the PROPOSED blocks E1-E3/E12-E13 and the hypotheses.
KEY NUMBERS NOTED: E6 recall@10 l1_br 0.04671 vs l1_br_euclid 0.06207 vs l1_only 0.06233 vs resample 0.06363; E6 gold prefix alive depth1/2/3/4: l1_br 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068 vs l1_br_euclid 1.000/0.829/0.161/0.085. E7 T4 NLL l1_br 9.03 vs l1_br_euclid 1.23. E8 share of canonical pairs sharing a K-cluster: K=16 0.3106, K=32 0.2164, K=64 0.1547, K=256 0.0822 (negatives 0.1352/0.0715/0.0376/0.0129). E5 branching spread B~2.7..41.4 successors. E10 mean_outgoing_degree 5.4526, distinct_edges 115582.
OPEN: weigh novelty/geometry against implementability; no verdict recorded yet.

STAGE: adjudication of the three contested dimensions.
GOAL: decide whether A's untested lever (moving the OT assignment plan) outweighs B's cheaper, more geometric lever (per-code curvature/cell sizing).
READ: my re-reading of E6, E7, E8 against the two novelty claims.
OBSERVED / REASONING: (i) NOVELTY: B's lever is the curvature/cell-size lever that the ledger has already pulled - successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463, l1_br 0.04671, all BELOW their Euclidean controls l1_br_euclid 0.06207 / l1_only 0.06233 (E6); B is a routine variation (novelty 2-3, exploration 2-3). A's diffusion of the plan matrix along E10's directed edges is absent from the ledger (ledger = rank matching, geodesic residuals, per-branch curvature, prefix losses) -> novelty 4, exploration 4.
(ii) BEHAVIOUR + FALSIFIABILITY: E6/E7 already show shallow prefix coherence RISING while recall FALLS (l1_br depth2/3 alive 1.000/1.000, recall 0.04671, T4 NLL 9.03). A pre-registers exactly that pattern as 'decorative' and requires Stage3 Recall@10 above the measured 0.06207-0.06363 control band. B lists falling H(next code | level0 code) as a positive signal - the metric that already misled in E6 - so B's falsifier is weaker.
(iii) GEOMETRY: B is more genuinely geometric (kappa derived in closed form from measured branching, entering argmin and commitment) but its own risk list admits the encoder can cancel the rescaling, and a per-code Euclidean distance scale would reproduce the argmin exactly -> caps at 3. A's fixed kappa=-1 ball is inherited and a Euclidean Sinkhorn with the same diffusion reproduces the plan -> 2. B wins this dimension by ~1 point.
(iv) IMPLEMENTABILITY: B clearly cheaper and fully specified (+2-4% step time, 1024 scalars); A's stated '5-8 MFLOPs' is wrong by orders (1024x1024x256 ~ 2.7e8 MACs per B_bt@P, x3 per level x3 levels) and alpha/q are unspecified. B wins by ~1.5 points.
NET: A takes both 20% blocks on behaviour-alignment and novelty and the 5% exploration term; B takes geometry (20%) and implementability (10%) plus part of downstream. A is the higher-information run and the only one whose failure is not a re-run of a measured negative.
OPEN: write the final answer record.

STAGE: FINAL ANSWER (complete block, stands alone).
GOAL: state which finalist I would run first, the decisive arguments, and the failure risk.
READ: rubric-2026-10-v1, IDEA A cocond-markov-poincare-ot, IDEA B CURVCELL-SID, evidence bundle 404ea254563870a6 / bc19762831440f87 / e9e97242e0e9ed08 (identical observed block E4-E11).
RESULT:
WINNER: cocond-markov-poincare-ot
FIRST LISTED: cocond-markov-poincare-ot
ARGUMENT: (1) novelty 20% + exploration 5% - B re-pulls the curvature/cell-size lever the ledger already measured negative: successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463 and l1_br 0.04671 all sit BELOW their Euclidean controls l1_br_euclid 0.06207 and l1_only 0.06233 (E6), so B is a routine variation (novelty 2-3); A's one-step Markov diffusion of the Sinkhorn plan along the directed edges of E10 (mean_outgoing_degree 5.4526) appears nowhere in the ledger (rank matching, geodesic residuals, per-branch curvature, prefix losses) and moves the assignment plan rather than the distance, so novelty 4 / exploration 4. (2) behaviour_evidence 20% + falsifiability 10% - E6/E7 show shallow prefix coherence rising while recall falls (l1_br prefix alive at depth 2/3 = 1.000/1.000, recall 0.04671, T4 NLL 9.03 vs 1.23 for its Euclidean control), and E8 caps behavioural-neighbour co-clustering at 0.0822 for K=256 (0.3106 only at K=16), so any prefix-coherence-only gain is already known to be decorative; A is the only proposal that pre-registers this exact pattern as failure ("if (a) rises while (c) does not, the coupling is producing decorative structure") and conditions success on Stage3 Recall@10 above the measured 0.06207-0.06363 control band, while B lists falling H(next code | level0 code) as a supporting outcome. (3) downstream_mechanism 15% - A names the affected assignment (argmax over the diffused plan at every level, j*(i), passed on as log_0(c_j*)), the observables (prefix hit-rate of the true next item's first two SID tokens on held-out prefixes, conditional code-usage entropy, Stage3 Recall@10) and the expected direction, against the measured baselines in E6; B's chain is equally specific but passes through an encoder that B's own risk list says can cancel the rescaling.
FAILURE RISK: the curvature half of A is ornamental - a matched Euclidean Sinkhorn with the same diffusion and a Euclidean weighted mean reproduces the plan and the codebook step, and E6 already has the Euclidean control beating the curved one (0.06207 vs 0.04671); second, the straight-through plus Sinkhorn normalisation can desynchronise codebook from encoder and collapse codes, leaving both (a) and (c) at baseline where the single seed cannot separate mechanism failure from seed noise; third, A's stated 5-8 MFLOPs is arithmetically wrong by orders of magnitude (1024x1024x256 per B_bt@P, x3 sweeps, x3 levels), so the frozen-budget claim must be re-measured before the run is trusted.
DIMENSION SCORECARD USED: A = behaviour 3-4, geometry 2, novelty 4, downstream 4, falsifiability 4, implementability 2-3, exploration 4; B = behaviour 3, geometry 3, novelty 2-3, downstream 4, falsifiability 3, implementability 4-5, exploration 2-3.
OPEN: nothing; this is the final record.
